statement.p: If possible, choose k so that the following function is continuous on any interval: f(x)= \begin{cases} \frac{7x^{3}-35x^{2}}{x-5}\quad \amp x \ne 5 \\ k \amp x = 5. \end{cases}

p.em: (If no k will make the function continuous, enter none)

static.solution:
k, the function is continuous on any interval that does not contain x=5.
Since 7 x^{3} - 35 x^{2} = 7 x^{2}(x - 5), we can cancel (x-5) provided x\ne 5, giving
f(x) = \frac{7x^{3}-35x^{2}}{x-5} = 7 x^{2},\quad\quad x\ne 5. Thus, if we pick k = 7 (5)^{2} = 175, the function is continuous.
